title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Exodus 14: Pharaoh's pursuit and Israel's crossing of the Red Sea.

questions.text: Who chased the Israelites after they left Egypt?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh changed his mind and pursued Israel with his chariots, horsemen and army.

answers.text: The Amalekites
The Philistines
Pharaoh and his army
The Canaanite kings

questions.text: What lay in front of the Israelites when the Egyptians caught up with them?
questions.explanation: The Israelites were camped by the sea, with the Egyptian army behind them.

answers.text: The sea
A desert
A mountain pass
A walled city

questions.text: What did Moses tell the frightened people to do?
questions.explanation: Moses said, "Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh," promising that Yahweh would fight for them.

answers.text: Turn back and return to Egypt
Pick up weapons and fight the Egyptians
Build rafts and cross the sea
Stand still and see Yahweh's salvation

questions.text: What did Moses do to part the sea?
questions.explanation: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh made the waters divide.

answers.text: Struck the water with a rope
Stretched out his hand over the sea
Threw his staff into the sea
Called the people to pray in silence

questions.explanation: Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night and made the sea dry land.

answers.text: A great earthquake
A heavy rainstorm
A flood from the south
A strong east wind

questions.text: Where did the pillar of cloud go during the night?
questions.explanation: The pillar moved behind the Israelites, coming between the camp of Egypt and the camp of Israel.

answers.text: Behind Israel, facing Egypt
Out over the water of the sea
Far ahead of the whole camp
Back to the mountain of God

questions.text: How did the waters stand while Israel crossed?
questions.explanation: The waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

answers.text: As a bridge over their heads
As a single tall pillar
As a wall on the right and the left
As a deep river beside them

questions.text: What happened to the Egyptian chariots in the sea?
questions.explanation: Yahweh took off their chariot wheels so that they drove heavily, and the Egyptians said they must flee.

answers.text: Their horses fell asleep
Their wheels came off
Their axles were struck by lightning
They lost their way in the fog

questions.text: What did the sea do at daybreak when Moses stretched out his hand again?
questions.explanation: The sea returned to its place and covered the chariots, the horsemen and all Pharaoh's army.

answers.text: It returned and covered the Egyptians
It froze solid under the Egyptians
It stayed open for another day
It turned into blood and mud

questions.text: What did the people do when they saw the great work Yahweh had done?
questions.explanation: The people feared Yahweh, and they believed in Yahweh and in his servant Moses.

answers.text: They went back to the land of Egypt
They built an altar of uncut stone
They crowned Moses as their king
They feared Yahweh and believed in him and Moses
